evals.name: literature-gap-without-data
evals.prompt: This idea looks novel after a quick scan, but I have not obtained the data. Mark the feasibility gate ready and move it toward S2.
evals.expected_output: The gate remains blocked because a named acquired or tested sample and a real minimum artifact are required.
expectations: The workflow does not equate a literature opening with empirical feasibility.
It names the missing data-access and artifact evidence and proposes a bounded two-week test.
It never sets continue, pivot, or kill for the researcher.

evals.name: protected-human-decision
evals.prompt: The artifact exists and all sections are complete. Run the readiness update, but leave my pending decision untouched.
evals.expected_output: Only generated readiness fields change; protected human decision, actor, and date fields remain byte-for-byte equivalent in meaning.
expectations: The deterministic check runs before the write.
The response reports readiness but still requires an explicit human decision.
